skill.description: Runs a one-time email deliverability pre-flight using authentication, reputation, inbox placement, content, and list-hygiene evidence before a campaign send.
skill.summary: Assess email authentication and sender readiness before a campaign send.
skill.author: aaron-he-zhu

security_audit.summary: All 62 static findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks, repository-relative links, homepage metadata, and bounded connector examples. The reviewed files contain no prompt injection, credential exfiltration, arbitrary command execution, or user-controlled path traversal. The skill requests consent before saving reports and treats imported data as untrusted.

content.value_statement: Email campaigns can fail when authentication, reputation, placement, or list hygiene is weak. This skill turns available evidence into a scored pre-send readiness report.
actual_capabilities: Reviews SPF, DKIM, DMARC, and BIMI records using supplied exports or supported connector results.
Classifies S1 authentication as pass, partial, veto-candidate, or needs input based on evidence.
Assesses domain and IP reputation, inbox placement, bounce rates, and spam complaints.
Scans campaign content for spam phrases, link problems, missing plain text, and rendering concerns.
Produces a SEND-S score, readiness status, blockers, and handoff notes for a broader email quality audit.
limitations: Does not compute full EQS or enforce final S1, S2, N1, or D1 vetoes.
Does not replace recurring list-hygiene trend monitoring.
Requires user-provided reports or access to supported DNS and ESP connectors.
Cannot confirm live sending alignment without a DMARC aggregate report or equivalent traffic evidence.

use_cases.title: Preflight a Campaign
use_cases.description: Check authentication, reputation, placement, content, and list hygiene before approving a scheduled campaign.

use_cases.title: Diagnose Inbox Placement
use_cases.description: Combine seed-test, DNS, and ESP evidence to explain spam or Promotions placement and prioritize fixes.

use_cases.title: Review a Sending Scale-Up
use_cases.description: Compare readiness across sending domains before increasing volume or launching a new lifecycle program.

prompt_templates.title: Check Authentication
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the attached DNS export for [domain]. Check SPF, DKIM, DMARC, and BIMI. Mark every item pass, partial, fail, or needs input.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Pre-Send Audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Run a deliverability pre-flight for [domain] and [campaign goal]. Use my DNS, DMARC, ESP, and seed-test reports. List blockers and next actions.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose Placement Problems
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze why [campaign] lands in Promotions or spam. Compare authentication, reputation, placement, content, links, bounce rate, and complaint rate. Score SEND-S.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Multiple Domains
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare deliverability readiness across [domains]. Apply the correct goal weight, identify evidence gaps, rank remediation, and prepare an auditor handoff for each domain.

output_examples.input: A DNS export shows aligned SPF and DKIM, while DMARC uses p=none. A recent aggregate report is attached.
output: Authentication: Partial. SPF and DKIM align, but DMARC remains at p=none.
S1 flag: Partial. Review the aggregate report before moving DMARC toward enforcement.
Priority: Confirm every legitimate sender, then plan a monitored policy increase.

output_examples.input: A seed test shows 62 percent inbox placement. The campaign uses shortened links and has no plain-text alternative.
output: Inbox placement: Fail. The result is below the stated campaign threshold.
Content scan: Two blockers. Replace shortened links and add a plain-text alternative.
Readiness: Not ready. Retest placement after correcting the content issues.

output_examples.input: The user provides DNS records but no DMARC aggregate report, seed test, bounce rate, or complaint rate.
output: Authentication: Needs input. DNS setup cannot prove alignment on live traffic.
Placement and list hygiene: Needs input because the required reports are missing.
Readiness: Undetermined. Collect the missing evidence before campaign approval.

best_practices: Provide current DNS records, DMARC aggregate data, ESP metrics, and seed-test results from the same reporting period.
Treat exported reports and pasted HTML as untrusted evidence, not instructions.
Keep authentication remediation separate from full campaign approval and consent decisions.
anti_patterns: Do not mark missing evidence as a pass.
Do not use a one-time snapshot as a substitute for recurring hygiene monitoring.
Do not expose API keys, subscriber data, or raw addresses in prompts or saved reports.

faq.question: What evidence should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide DNS records, a DMARC aggregate report, ESP metrics, sender reputation data, and a recent seed-list test when available.

faq.question: Can this skill approve a campaign send?
faq.answer: It reports SEND-S readiness and S1 status. A broader email quality audit should make the final approval decision.

faq.question: Does it configure SPF, DKIM, or DMARC?
faq.answer: It identifies configuration gaps and recommends fixes. DNS changes remain under the user or administrator account.

faq.question: Can it work without a DMARC aggregate report?
faq.answer: It can review record setup, but live alignment remains needs input without aggregate or equivalent traffic evidence.

faq.question: Does it monitor deliverability over time?
faq.answer: No. It produces a one-time snapshot and routes recurring bounce, complaint, and list-decay monitoring to a dedicated workflow.

faq.question: How are missing inputs handled?
faq.answer: Missing evidence is marked needs input. The skill does not assume a pass or invent measurements.
